metadata.derivation: CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative of Andrea Volpato's kodak_gold_200. Stable dye spectra, base absorption, shoulders and base Hanatos calibration retained. Manufacturer relative sensitivity contributes 20% after daylight normalization; midtone slope adjusts contrast by at most 10%. A creative colour approximation, NOT a measured or independently validated reproduction of the named stock.
metadata.density_inverse: Not performed: no Status-M or narrow-band inverse in revision 2
metadata.exposure_convention: Base film's D55 integrated sensitivity retained per channel; ISO/EI is display metadata
metadata.source_spectra_usage: Minimum and neutral absorption are archived source observations, not used to reconstruct dyes
metadata.hanatos_calibration: Inherited base-film calibration, not independently fitted for the named stock
